name: CompGS
aliases: Efficient 3D Scene Representation via Compressed Gaussian Splatting
definition: A hybrid primitive structure with anchor primitives to predict attributes of coupled primitives, resulting in compact residual representations.
summary: CompGS compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting using a hybrid structure of anchor and coupled primitives that predicts attributes from anchors, differing from methods relying on global quantization or pruning.
